column3: “the Jordan at Jericho” renders “the Jordan of Jericho”; NASB supplies “into” and “to.”
“from Bethel to Luz” renders “from Bethel toward Luz.”
“territory” renders “border”; “it ended at the sea” renders “its extremities were toward the sea.”
NASB supplies “at” before “Michmethath”; “beyond it to the east of Janoah” renders “passed by it on the east to Janoah.”
“the brook of Kanah” renders “the wadi of Kanah”; “it ended at the sea” renders “its extremities were toward the sea.”
NASB supplies “together with … which were set apart.”
“drive out” renders “dispossess”; “forced laborers” renders “a slave gang of labor.”
